## Purpose

Describe the change and the evidence it adds to the storefront.

## Upstream contribution gate

Complete this section when adding a case study:

- [ ] I read every comment on the upstream issue.
- [ ] I searched both open and closed pull requests.
- [ ] The issue was unassigned and no contributor had already claimed the work.
- [ ] I read the upstream contribution guide, PR template, and AI policy.
- [ ] I announced intent according to the upstream project's policy.
- [ ] I reproduced the failure against a pinned current upstream commit.
- [ ] I implemented the fix and added a regression test.
- [ ] I ran the focused and adjacent verification suites.
- [ ] I opened the upstream pull request before adding the case study.
- [ ] The case study links the issue, intent comment, and upstream pull request.
- [ ] The portfolio classification matches the upstream PR's actual state.
